scope: Saint Kitts and Nevis medical discovery — Windsor University School of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: WUSOM's official admissions page describes a four-year MD pathway, undergraduate-entry coursework, three annual intakes, application documents, and a St. Kitts campus address.
WUSOM's current partner page describes 20 months of basic sciences in St. Kitts followed by 72 weeks of clinical rotations, and names US clinical partners including ACCESS Community Health Network.
CAAM-HP's assessed-programme register lists Windsor University School of Medicine in Saint Kitts and Nevis as on probation for two years, 2025–2027, last updated July 2025.

WUSOM's admissions page says tuition starts at US$5,840 per semester, while its current homepage describes basic-science tuition of about US$7,190 per semester and clinical-science tuition of about US$11,490; the published figures are not internally consistent.

holdReasons: The institution's current page labels the school CAAM-HP accredited, but CAAM-HP's current register states probation for 2025–2027. Do not present an unqualified accreditation claim.
Current official tuition pages give inconsistent starting figures and no verified fully itemised 2026 cost schedule was retrieved.

The regulator's current institutional permission, English-language requirement, named clinical-site agreements, capacity, scholarship, loan and housing eligibility require direct current policy evidence.
nextAction: Keep held. Resolve the CAAM-HP status with the provider and regulator, obtain one effective-date fee schedule, and verify current clinical and international-student policies before considering a payload.
